counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 为 Replit Slides 应用八套专业主题
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在 Replit 上做演示文稿并想快速换肤。
copy.tagline_en: Apply eight professional themes to Replit Slides
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you create presentations on Replit and want quick theme changes.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要求制作 Replit Slides 风格的幻灯片时，它会生成一份单文件、可横向滑动的演示文稿，依次为封面、目录、正文和收尾，并让你从八套主题中选一套全程使用。
howto.when: 当你说要制作 Replit Slides 风格的幻灯片，或提到 helix、holm、vance 等主题名时，它会接管并开始生成。

say.text: 用 helix 主题做一份旅行计划幻灯片。
say.note: 它会按 helix 配色生成 cover 和内容页。

say.text: 把这份市场分析做成 world-mint 风格的 deck。
say.note: 内容会拆成多页，覆盖所有要点。

say.text: 做一个 bluehouse 主题的产品发布演示。
say.note: 结构含 agenda，全程用该主题。

howto.what_en: When asked for Replit Slides-style slides, Claude produces a single-file horizontal-swipe deck with cover, agenda, content, and ending, and instructs you to choose one of eight themes and stick to it.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask for a Replit Slides-style presentation or name a theme like helix, holm, or vance.

say_en.text: Make a travel plan slideshow with the helix theme.
say_en.note: It will generate cover and content pages in helix colors.

say_en.text: Turn this market analysis into a world-mint styled deck.
say_en.note: The content will be split into pages covering all points.

say_en.text: Create a product launch demo with the bluehouse theme.
say_en.note: The structure will include an agenda, using the theme throughout.
